reasons.plausibility: The proposed selective oxidation/reduction mechanism at grain boundaries involving Al and Cr is consistent with current understanding of high-temperature degradation in high-entropy alloys, making it scientifically credible though not yet fully proven in detail.
reasons.testability: The experimental plan, with controlled environments, in-situ microscopy, and direct microstructural and mechanical assessments, provides a clear route to validate or refute the hypothesized intergranular failure mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: If confirmed, the findings would be highly valuable to guide processing and compositional strategies that mitigate intergranular degradation in such alloys, thus it is very helpful to researchers in this field.
